# LokTube 1.5.1

- Place the new-tab **+** button directly after the last open tab rather than anchoring it to the right edge of the tab bar.
- Keep the button inside the tab strip's horizontal scrolling area so it follows the tabs when the row overflows.
- Preserve tab selection, closing, drag-and-drop reordering, and background tab behavior.
- Add a desktop regression check for the button's position.

- Register a validated **loktube:** protocol. YouTube links opened from
  the browser create **new LokTube tabs**, preserving existing playback.
- Include a **Zen/Firefox Violentmonkey userscript** to automatically
  forward normal clicked YouTube links. Installation instructions in
  `docs/BROWSER_LINKS.md`. Address-bar navigation is not intercepted.
- Reject unrelated websites and unsafe paths, without exchanging cookies.

All 1.5.0 recommendation filtering and existing account data remain unchanged.
